misprints.note: First occurrence, line 1: there is no apostrophe after ἐπ, but the same phrase on the next line has one.
The 'l' at the end of the line has no stop; it may have dropped out at the margin.

misprints.probably_meant: ἀκροβόλιον (cf. Ankarplats on the same page), or perhaps ἀγκυροβόλιον
misprints.note: Ankring: printed with α in the middle, where Ankarplats in the same column has ἀκροβόλιον.
Gloss after 'angående ... m. gen.'; it is clearly printed 'ankommande' and kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The circumflex of μεῖν sits at the bottom edge of strip 0020_01's image, not in this strip; the reading μεῖν (ἐπιθυμεῖν) is reconstructed.
In the low-resolution view ιδος appeared to have an accent; at higher zoom it shows none, so it is written as plain ιδος.
